CustomField.description: How many paid orders have used this code. Only meaningful alongside Max Redemptions. This field is NOT maintained by the order form: a buyer who reaches the payment page and abandons it must not burn a redemption, so counting belongs to the paid-order pipeline, not to the browser. Until that is wired up, treat this as a manual count.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Paid orders that used this code. Not updated by the order form - see the field description.
CustomField.label: Times Redeemed
